title: India A Face Pakistan A on November 22 in Asia Cup Rising Stars
excerpt: The ACC has announced the Doha schedule for November 19-29: India A open against Nepal on November 20, meet Pakistan A on November 22, and close Group B against the UAE on November 24.
body:
• The ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026 runs in Doha, Qatar, from November 19 to 29, with eight teams split into two groups of four.
  • India A are in Group B with Pakistan A, Nepal and the UAE, and face Pakistan A in the marquee group clash on November 22 at 1 pm local time.
  • India A open against Nepal on November 20 and close the group stage against the UAE on November 24; the top two in each group reach semi-finals on November 26 and 27, with the final on November 29.
  • For diaspora fans, India A's matches against Nepal and the UAE carry official List A status, and the Nepal-UAE game counts as an official ODI — results here feed the senior-team pipeline.

India A and Pakistan A drawn together again

India A will face Pakistan A on November 22 in Doha after the Asian Cricket Council announced the groups and schedule for the ACC Men's Asia Cup Rising Stars 2026. The eight-team tournament, hosted by the Qatar Cricket Association, runs from November 19 to 29 at the West End International Cricket Stadium and the University of Doha for Science and Technology ground.

https://x.com/NewsWireLK/status/2114003516771664294

India A and Pakistan A are drawn in Group B alongside Nepal and the United Arab Emirates. Group A comprises Sri Lanka A, Bangladesh A, Afghanistan A and Hong Kong, China. The five A teams come from the full-member nations, while Nepal, Hong Kong, China and the UAE field their senior national sides after earning their places through the ACC Men's Premier Cup in Malaysia.

India A's road through Group B

India A open their campaign against Nepal on November 20 at 1 pm local time, then play the marquee clash against Pakistan A on November 22, also at 1 pm local time, before closing the group stage against the UAE on November 24 at 9 am local time, according to the IANS report carried by Cricketnmore. Pakistan A's other fixtures are against the UAE on November 20 and Nepal on November 24, while Nepal and the UAE meet each other on November 22.

The group stage is a single round-robin. The top two teams from each group progress to the semi-finals on November 26 and 27, and the final is on November 29. The tournament follows a 50-over format, BDCricTime reported, with Bangladesh A playing Hong Kong, China and Sri Lanka A facing Afghanistan A on the opening day, November 19.

Why this edition carries extra weight

The Rising Stars tournament is Asia's main showcase for the next generation below senior international cricket, and this edition gives its results formal standing. All matches between Nepal or the UAE and any full-member A team carry official List A status, so India A's games against Nepal and the UAE both count as List A fixtures, while the match between Nepal and the UAE is an official ODI.

There is also a score to settle. LatestLY noted that India A will be keen to avenge their defeat to Pakistan A in the 2025 edition, where Pakistan A secured an eight-wicket victory. If both rivals win their semi-finals, they would meet again in the November 29 final. The A-team clash is the second India-Pakistan meeting of the month: India Under-19 and Pakistan Under-19 are scheduled to meet in the Under-19 Asia Cup on November 8, in a tournament running November 5 to 14 in Oman.

What to watch

Squad announcements will decide how strong each A side is, and they are the next news to watch before November 19. For diaspora fans following from the US, the practical dates are already fixed: India A versus Nepal on November 20, India A versus Pakistan A on November 22, and India A versus the UAE on November 24, all in Doha, with a possible final on November 29. Mark November 22 first — at 1 pm Doha time, it is the group game most likely to decide who tops Group B.
